setcpm(240/4)

$: note("c3 e3")
  .s("sine")
  .gain(0.06)
  .jux(p => stack(p.iter(3), p.off(0.25, q => stack(q.fast(2), q.rev()))))
  .orbit(1)

setcpm(240/4)

$: note("c3 e3")
  .s("sine")
  .gain(0.06)
  .jux(p => (shared => stack(shared, shared.off(0.25, q => (inner => stack(inner, inner.rev()))(q.fast(2)))))(p.iter(3)))
  .orbit(1)
